## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Fixes #(issue number) / Relates to #(issue number)

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or user capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, dependencies, or repository hygiene
- [ ] `refactor`: Code reorganization without functional changes
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests

---

## Areas Changed

- [ ] Backend API / Django models / Serializers
- [ ] Frontend UI / React components / Hooks
- [ ] Grist synchronization / Widgets
- [ ] ProConnect / Keycloak authentication
- [ ] Docker Compose / Makefile / CI configuration
- [ ] Documentation / Specifications

---

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding guidelines (English only, functions <= 60 lines, tabs in frontend, 4 spaces in backend).
- [ ] I have run `make test` locally and all 111+ tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend build succeeds without TypeScript or Vite errors (`npm run build`).
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration is valid (`docker compose config`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if necessary.
